RAG Foundry pipeline flow

From uploading a corpus to a checked, cited answer. Click any stage to see every technique available there, the router that chooses between them, and how that choice is measured. Use the demo pickers to see an example route.

Routers

Many small routers, one per decision, behind one shared contract. A pipeline orchestrator collects their decisions into one route plan per document or question. Details: docs/architecture/ROUTER_DESIGN.md.
